How to play

Place the cue ball on the felt and tap Place Ball. Drag across the table to aim, set Power, then tap Hit.

Open Spin for topspin, backspin or sidespin. Your view stays flat while you aim and shoot.

Use Find opponent in the app to play another member. Each player controls only their own turn.
